title: statusline r15 UX: absent settings contradicts the offer path
description: Round 15. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Citations verified: contract:162 vs :219, :187. Proposed: resolved-candidate (plainly-absent = offer path, stated at boundary and requirement; the settings failure kinds are malformed, absent-with-probe-error — an inaccessible path — and permission/IO).
